text:
Liam H: Heads up — since the 04:05 deploy I'm seeing a class of traces where child spans never arrive. Root span shows up, but no db/cache spans. metrics: exporter_429_count spiked.
Mira K: Which exporter? otel-collector -> redis-exporter or the new http-exporter?
Liam H: http-exporter (v2). Logs show repeated 429s then backoff. snippet: 
```
2026-03-18T04:06:12Z http-exporter warn: 429 Too Many Requests - retrying in 1200ms (attempt=3)
2026-03-18T04:06:12Z batcher debug: flush(512) -> dropped=12 due to exporter_error
```
Jamal R: Are the child spans being dropped before batching, or getting dropped by the exporter on ingest?
Nina S: Initial suspicion: exporter returning 429 triggers quick retry/backoff which causes the collector to flush incomplete batches and drop queued child spans. We saw similar behavior when batch size > queue capacity.
Simon L: Can we confirm queue depth and drop counter from otelcol? `receiver.memory_queue.dropped_spans_total`?
Liam H: Adding metrics: memory_queue_dropped=930 in last 10m; exporter_retries=2400; exporter_429_count=2400.
Mira K: If exporter responds 429 often, the collector's backpressure kicks in. Current config: 
```
exporters:
  http/v2:
    max_retries: 5
    retry_wait: 1s
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      exporters: [http/v2]
processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 200ms
    send_batch_max_size: 512
    send_batch_max_bytes: 0
```
Jamal R: That batch timeout looks aggressive — small timeout + large max_size means partial flushes on backoff. Suggest increasing timeout and lowering max_size to reduce partial flushes.
Liam H: Quick mitigation: route traffic to fallback exporter in the routing policy? Is there a canary?
Mira K: We have fallback to scribe-exporter but it's slower and not tested for full traffic. We could enable it for the affected shard for a few minutes.
deploy-bot: deploy started: enable-fallback-exporter-for-trace-shard-7 by Mira K — 1 step remaining
Simon L: Also add a guard: when exporter responds 429 repeatedly, stop immediate flush of partial batches — treat as transient and hold for at least 1s before forced flush.
Nina S: Filed an infra task for config change + temporary fallback: INFRA-2348. Will do config tweak on otelcol and enable fallback on shard 7.
Mira K: Rolling config change pushed to collector pool for shard 7. Will monitor metrics.
Liam H: After change: exporter_429_count down, memory_queue_dropped down to 12 in 5m. I still see ~2% of traces missing children — could be race during rollout.
Jamal R: Follow-up: we should add an integration test for exporter 429 behavior (simulate 429s and verify no child span loss). Also add a dashboard panel for memory_queue_dropped and partial_flush_count.
Mira K: Agreed. I'll open a PR with config default: timeout 1s, max_size 128, and add docs note.
ops-bot: incident-note created: "traces: child-span loss during exporter 429 surge" id=INC-2026-03-18-01
Liam H: Thanks all — keeping thread open for postmortem notes.
Mira K: Postmortem remind: consider making exporter fallback a first-class routing policy (priority list) so we can avoid manual toggles.
Simon L: Also add a telemetry alert: memory_queue_dropped > 100 in 5m triggers paging.
Nina S: Will include suggested runbook steps in INFRA-2348.
Liam H: Closing this thread after we verify two hours of stable metrics."
